content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Project Research Scientist-III (Medical)
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi, under an Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) funded research project (code No. I-1910) based at the Centre for Dental Education and Research (CDER) under Dr. Varun Surya. The project focuses on evaluating the efficacy of allogeneic mesenchymal stem cells in reducing fibrosis and enhancing muscle regeneration in patients suffering from oral submucous fibrosis through a randomized controlled trial.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements stipulated for the position. Essential Qualification: MDS in Oral Medicine or Oral Pathology with a minimum of 3 years of experience after MDS. Desirable Experience: Hands-on experience in biopsy techniques and a sound understanding of research methodology.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 93,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA), strictly governed by the applicable ICMR and AIIMS guidelines. All salaries and experience requirements will be as per ICMR guidelines.
